---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change or addition to the plugin
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem are you trying to solve?**
Describe the problem first, independent of any specific solution — this plugin is deliberately
stack-agnostic, so a proposal needs to make sense beyond your own project's conventions.

**Proposed solution**
What you'd like to happen. If it changes agent behavior (`agents/*.md`) or the workflow
(`workflows/deliver-pipeline.js`), say which stage(s) are affected.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about, and why you didn't go with them.

**Additional context**
Anything else — links, examples from other tools, etc.
